title: AI wedding speech writer for best men and maids of honor

source.text: An AI app that writes a personalized wedding speech for best men and maids of honor, $19 per speech. Countries US then FR. Budget 0, 5 hours a week, goal side income, no special edge. Just go: do not ask questions. Use the slug wedding-speeches.

problem: Best men and maids of honor must give a personal, funny, moving speech and most dread writing it.
customer: Best men and maids of honor (US, mostly aged 25-35) with a wedding 1-6 weeks away
solution: A web app that interviews the user about the couple and generates a personalized speech with AI
assumptions: Budget USD 0: no paid ads, only free tiers and organic channels
5 hours a week, solo founder, side income goal
No audience, network or wedding-industry asset (stated: no special edge)
Founder can build a simple web app with an LLM API (not stated; assumed from the idea)
Type saas: an AI web app, sold one-off per speech
US first, France second, as stated

answers.question: Do you already have an audience, a list or a wedding-industry partner?
answers.answer: Not asked (headless run, user said just go). Assumed no: the user stated no special edge.
answers.effect: no change: no_distribution stays a hit
